name: Harlan Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven
description: A 5.5-quart cast iron pot with a satin enamel glaze in farmhouse colors, built for slow braises, no-knead bread and Sunday soups. The heavy lid traps steam and the wide loop handles clear oven mitts with room to spare. It lives on the stovetop between meals and looks right doing so in a warm, cozy kitchen.
details: Capacity 5.5 qt / 5.2 L; 10.25 in diameter, 4.5 in deep
Cast iron with three-layer porcelain enamel; cream interior
Oven safe to 500°F; works on gas, electric and induction
Hand wash recommended; dishwasher safe but enamel will dull over time
Weight 12.4 lb with lid
Made in France

name: Nakata Carbon Steel Skillet
description: A spun carbon steel pan with a riveted black steel handle and a blued-metal finish that darkens with every use. It heats fast, sears hard and gets more non-stick the longer you own it, like a cast iron pan that weighs half as much. Spare and utilitarian, it hangs on a rail and suits a calm, pared-back kitchen.
details: 10 in diameter (8.25 in cooking surface), 1.75 in deep; 12 in size also available
2 mm carbon steel; pre-seasoned with flaxseed oil
Induction, gas, electric and open-flame compatible; oven safe to 600°F
Hand wash only, dry immediately and oil lightly; never dishwasher
Weight 2.9 lb (10 in)
Made in Japan

name: Lindqvist Stainless Saucepan
description: A 3-quart tri-ply saucepan with a brushed stainless body and a pale ash wood handle that stays cool on the stovetop. The straight sides and tight-fitting lid make it the pan for rice, grains, sauces and reheating soup, and the brushed finish hides water spots. Quiet and clean, it was designed to sit on open shelving without asking for attention.
details: Capacity 3 qt / 2.8 L; 7.5 in diameter, 4.25 in deep
Tri-ply 18/10 stainless steel with full aluminum core
Oiled ash handle on a stainless tang; lid in stainless with ash knob
Body is dishwasher safe; hand wash the handle to preserve the wood
Induction compatible; oven safe to 350°F
Made in Portugal

name: Orla Enameled Steel Stockpot
description: An 8-quart enameled steel pot in burnt orange with a cream interior and a chunky cream-capped knob, lifted from the pots your grandmother boiled pasta in. It is light enough to carry full to the sink and the glossy glaze wipes clean of tomato sauce. Warm, a little groovy and happy to be left out on the back burner.
details: Capacity 8 qt / 7.6 L; 10 in diameter, 7.5 in deep
Carbon steel body with vitreous enamel inside and out
Lid included; phenolic knob rated to 400°F
Dishwasher safe; avoid metal utensils on the enamel
Weight 4.6 lb with lid
Made in Turkey

name: Volta Ceramic Nonstick Fry Pan
description: A cast aluminum fry pan with a PFAS-free ceramic coating and an exterior that comes in cobalt, pomegranate and chartreuse, with a bakelite handle in a clashing second color. Eggs slide, cleanup is a rinse, and the pan weighs less than a bag of flour. It is the loud, playful piece on a stove full of grey.
details: 10 in diameter, 2 in deep; 8 in size also available
Cast aluminum body with sol-gel ceramic nonstick interior; no PTFE or PFAS
Stay-cool bakelite handle; oven safe to 350°F
Dishwasher safe; hand washing extends the coating's life
Induction compatible via bonded stainless base
Weight 1.9 lb (10 in)

name: Fenwick Copper Sauté Pan
description: A 3.5-quart sauté pan in polished copper with a brass handle and a tin-lined interior that responds to the flame the moment you touch the dial. It develops a soft rose patina if you let it and polishes back to a mirror if you don't. Glamorous enough to hang on the wall, serious enough to make a proper pan sauce.
details: Capacity 3.5 qt / 3.3 L; 11 in diameter, 2.5 in deep
2 mm solid copper with hand-tinned interior; cast brass handle and lid knob
Not induction compatible; gas and electric only; oven safe to 450°F
Hand wash only; polish with copper cream to keep the shine
Weight 4.1 lb with lid
Made in Italy

name: Ridge Stoneware Dinner Plate (Set of 4)
description: Four wheel-thrown stoneware plates with a low lip and a speckled Oat glaze that pools slightly darker toward the center. The clay is a dark-firing stoneware, so each unglazed foot ring shows the iron underneath, and no two plates match exactly. Calm, matte and quietly imperfect, they make an ordinary weeknight look considered.
details: 10.5 in diameter, 1 in rim height; set of 4
Iron-rich stoneware clay, reduction-fired to cone 10
Glazes: Oat (speckled cream), Ink (satin black), Ash (pale grey)
Dishwasher and microwave safe; oven safe to 400°F
Slight variation in glaze and form is part of the piece
Made in Portugal

name: Mabry Stoneware Cereal Bowl (Set of 4)
description: Four deep, generous bowls in a glossy cream glaze with a hand-painted stripe at the rim in cornflower blue or barn red. They take porridge, chili and a pint of ice cream equally well and stack without rattling. Homely, cheerful and heavy enough in the hand to feel like something that will outlast the kitchen.
details: 6.25 in diameter, 3 in tall; holds 24 oz / 710 ml; set of 4
Buff stoneware clay with a lead-free glossy cream glaze
Rim stripe hand-painted under the glaze, so it will not wear off
Dishwasher, microwave and freezer safe
Made in Portugal

name: Tide Porcelain Dinnerware Set (16-Piece)
description: A four-place setting in thin, light porcelain with an organic coupe edge, glazed in a watery Seafoam that fades to white at the rim. It reads like beach glass on a linen tablecloth and is thin enough to feel refined without being precious. Airy and bright, it suits a dining room that gets a lot of morning light.
details: Includes 4 dinner plates (10.75 in), 4 salad plates (8.5 in), 4 bowls (7 in, 28 oz), 4 mugs (12 oz)
High-fired porcelain, chip-resistant and non-porous
Glazes: Seafoam, Sand, White
Dishwasher, microwave and oven safe to 350°F
Open stock available for replacements
Made in Portugal

name: Sunniva Pasta Bowl (Set of 4)
description: Four wide, shallow bowls in a matte white or pale grey glaze with a clean, unfussy rim and nothing else to look at. The shape holds a nest of pasta, a grain bowl or a Saturday salad and gives you room to get a fork under it. Soft, pale and restful, it disappears into a quiet table so the food can do the talking.
details: 9 in diameter, 2 in deep; holds 32 oz / 950 ml; set of 4
White stoneware clay with a satin-matte glaze
Glazes: Chalk (white), Fog (pale grey)
Dishwasher and microwave safe
Stackable to 1.5 in per bowl
Made in Portugal

name: Bellamy Terracotta Serving Platter
description: A long oval platter in red terracotta clay with a hand-painted border of white dashes and dots, glazed only on the inside so the rough clay shows at the edge. It carries roasted vegetables, a whole fish or a spread of mezze from oven to the middle of the table. Earthy, textured and a little sun-faded, like something carried home from a market.
details: 16 in long, 10 in wide, 1.75 in deep
Red terracotta clay, interior glazed in Bone white with hand-painted motif
Oven safe to 400°F; not microwave safe (unglazed exterior)
Hand wash; the unglazed rim will absorb water and dry naturally
Each piece painted by hand; motifs vary
Made in Tunisia

name: Juno Dessert Plate (Set of 4)
description: Four scalloped-edge dessert plates, each in a different high-gloss glaze: Emerald, Fuchsia, Saffron and Lapis, with a hand-painted gold squiggle across the center. They are for cake, for cheese, for a 4 pm biscuit, and for a table where nothing is expected to match. Bold, playful and more is more.
details: 8 in diameter with 12-point scalloped rim; set of 4 (one of each color)
White earthenware with lead-free gloss glazes
22k gold luster accent; hand wash only, not microwave safe
Stackable; slight glaze pooling at the scallops is normal
Made in Portugal

name: Atlas Reactive Glaze Mug (Set of 4)
description: Four tapered mugs with a squared-off handle and a reactive glaze that breaks from mustard to olive, or teal to walnut brown, where the clay is thinnest. The shape tips back toward the diner mugs of the 1960s, with a slightly flared lip that drinks well. Warm, retro and a little different each time you pull one from the cupboard.
details: Holds 12 oz / 355 ml; 3.75 in tall, 3.25 in diameter
Buff stoneware with a two-tone reactive glaze; set of 4 in one colorway
Colorways: Mustard/Olive, Teal/Walnut
Dishwasher and microwave safe
Reactive glaze means variation between mugs is expected
Made in Portugal

name: Solenne Gilded Side Plate (Set of 4)
description: Four fine bone china side plates with a fluted rim and a hand-applied band of burnished gold, in Noir, Emerald or Ivory. The fluting catches candlelight in a way flat plates never do, and the china rings when you tap it. Polished, geometric and made for the dinner party you keep meaning to throw.
details: 8.5 in diameter with 24 flutes; set of 4
Bone china, translucent at the rim
22k gold band applied by hand and fired a third time
Hand wash only; not microwave safe
Gift boxed
Made in Portugal

name: Foundry Stoneware Serving Bowl
description: A deep, straight-sided serving bowl in a grey stoneware that looks like poured concrete, with a raw unglazed exterior and a slick charcoal glaze inside. The heft is real: this is a bowl for a family-size salad or a mound of roast potatoes, set down with a thud in the middle of a reclaimed-wood table. Raw, honest and built like something from a workshop.
details: 11 in diameter, 4.5 in deep; holds 4 qt / 3.8 L
Grey stoneware with grog for texture; exterior left unglazed and sanded smooth
Interior satin charcoal glaze
Dishwasher safe; unglazed exterior may show water marks briefly
Weight 4.2 lb
Made in Portugal

name: Soren Stemless Wine Glass (Set of 4)
description: Four stemless glasses in thin, seamless crystal with a gently tapered bowl that works for a Riesling at lunch and water with dinner. The walls are fine enough to feel light in the hand but the base is weighted so they do not tip on a linen cloth. Clear, quiet and easy to stack in a small cupboard.
details: Holds 15 oz / 445 ml; 4.5 in tall, 3.25 in widest diameter; set of 4
Lead-free crystal glass, machine blown with a laser-cut rim
Dishwasher safe on the top rack
Weight 5.6 oz each
Made in Slovakia

name: Ember Smoked Glass Tumbler (Set of 4)
description: Four chunky tumblers in smoked amber or bronze glass with a slightly bulged profile and a thick base, pulled straight from a 1970s sideboard bar. They turn an ordinary iced coffee or whisky soda the color of late afternoon. Warm, curved and heavy enough to feel like something.
details: Holds 11 oz / 325 ml; 3.75 in tall, 3.25 in diameter; set of 4
Soda-lime glass, color through the body (not a coating)
Colors: Amber, Bronze, Olive
Dishwasher safe
Weight 9.5 oz each
Made in Turkey

name: Marin Recycled Glass Tumbler (Set of 6)
description: Six hand-blown tumblers made from 100% recycled bottles, with a faint sea-green tint and the tiny bubbles that come with it. They are tall enough for iced tea and sturdy enough to carry out to the porch in a stack. Light-filled, breezy and the kind of glass you stop worrying about.
details: Holds 13 oz / 385 ml; 4.75 in tall, 3 in diameter; set of 6
100% post-consumer recycled glass, hand blown; bubbles and slight size variation are normal
Tints: Sea Green, Clear, Sky
Dishwasher safe
Made in Mexico

name: Vesper Fluted Coupe (Set of 2)
description: A pair of champagne coupes with a vertically fluted bowl, a faceted stem and an optional gilded rim, modeled on the glasses in a 1930s hotel bar. The ridges throw light around the table and the wide bowl is just as good for a gimlet as it is for fizz. Polished, geometric and a reason to open the good bottle.
details: Holds 7 oz / 210 ml; 6 in tall, 4 in diameter; set of 2
Lead-free crystal, mouth blown and hand cut
Clear or with 24k gold rim
Hand wash only (gold rim); clear version is top-rack dishwasher safe
Gift boxed
Made in Czech Republic

name: Bastion Heavy-Base Rocks Glass (Set of 4)
description: Four straight-sided rocks glasses with a thick, slightly off-level base that looks like it was cast rather than blown. The glass is clear and heavy, with a faint grey cast, and takes a large ice cube with room for two fingers of whatever. Utilitarian, unornamented and right at home on a steel bar cart.
details: Holds 10 oz / 295 ml; 3.5 in tall, 3.25 in diameter; set of 4
Pressed soda-lime glass with a 1 in solid base
Dishwasher safe
Weight 14 oz each
Made in USA

name: Tamsin Walnut End-Grain Cutting Board
description: A thick end-grain board in black walnut, with a checkered pattern that comes from how the blocks are glued up rather than any stain. End grain is kind to knives and heals its own cut marks, and the walnut deepens to a dark chocolate with oil. Low, warm and organic, it stays out on the counter as the thing people lean on while you cook.
details: 16 x 12 x 1.75 in; 14 x 10 size also available
Solid black walnut, end-grain construction; rubber feet on the underside
Finished with food-grade mineral oil and beeswax
Hand wash and dry upright; re-oil monthly; never dishwasher or soaked
Weight 8.5 lb (16 x 12)
Made in USA

name: Kiso Hinoki Cutting Board
description: A single plank of pale Japanese cypress, planed smooth and left unfinished so the wood's faint lemon scent comes through when it gets wet. Hinoki is soft enough to be gentle on a sharp knife and naturally resists bacteria, which is why Japanese kitchens have used it for centuries. Spare, pale and calm, it is a board for someone who owns one good knife.
details: 15 x 9.5 x 1 in
Solid hinoki (Japanese cypress), single plank, no glue or finish
Hand wash with cold water and dry on edge; never soak or dishwasher
Will lighten and mark with use; sand lightly to refresh
Weight 2.1 lb
Made in Japan

name: Hearth Acacia Serving Board
description: A long, live-edge board in acacia with a tan-and-walnut grain that runs like a map, finished with a hand-wrapped jute cord through the handle hole. It was made for a cheese spread, a loaf of bread or a row of tacos passed down a crowded table. Layered, textured and happy to sit on a stack of other boards.
details: 20 x 8 in, 0.75 in thick, with a natural live edge on one side
Solid acacia with a food-safe oil finish; jute hanging cord
Hand wash and dry; re-oil every few months
Grain and edge vary piece to piece
Made in Indonesia

name: Bergen Ash Utensil Set (Set of 5)
description: Five pale ash utensils turned from a single species of wood so they all age together: a spatula, a slotted turner, a spoon, a tasting spoon and a stirring paddle. The handles are slim, oval and sanded to a soft hand, and the whole set stands in the included crock. Clean, quiet and light in the hand, the way a wooden spoon should be.
details: Spatula 12.5 in, slotted turner 12 in, spoon 12 in, paddle 11 in, tasting spoon 7 in
Solid European ash with a food-safe linseed oil finish
Includes a matte white stoneware crock, 5.5 in tall
Hand wash and air dry; re-oil as needed; not dishwasher safe
Made in Lithuania

name: Hollowell Beech Bread Board
description: A paddle-shaped board in pale steamed beech with a long handle, a hanging hole and a shallow crumb groove routed around the edge. It is the right size for a sourdough loaf and the right look for hanging on a hook by the stove. Homely, cream-toned and a little old-fashioned, in the best way.
details: 22 x 9 in including handle, 0.75 in thick
Solid steamed beech with a food-safe oil finish
Crumb groove on the cutting face; hanging hole in the handle
Hand wash and dry on edge; re-oil every few months
Weight 1.8 lb
Made in Romania

name: Lisle Washed Linen Napkin (Set of 4)
description: Four generously sized napkins in stonewashed European flax, with a raw-edge hem that frays softly with washing. They come in sand, sea blue and white, the palette of a beach house in October, and get softer and more rumpled every time they go through the machine. Airy, breezy and fine to leave slightly creased.
details: 20 x 20 in; set of 4
100% European flax linen, stonewashed; 185 gsm
Colors: Sand, Sea Blue, White, Oat Stripe
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low; no need to iron
Oeko-Tex certified
Made in Portugal

name: Marigold Block-Print Tablecloth
description: A heavy cotton tablecloth hand block-printed in Jaipur with a repeating marigold-and-vine motif in terracotta and indigo on a natural ground. The print is slightly uneven at the edges, which is how you know it was stamped by hand, and the cotton drapes with real weight. Collected, layered and warm, it turns a plain table into the center of the room.
details: Rectangle 60 x 90 in (seats 6) or 60 x 120 in (seats 8)
100% cotton canvas, 220 gsm, hand block-printed with azo-free dyes
Colorways: Terracotta, Indigo
Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry; colors will soften with washing
Made in India

name: Thistle Gingham Table Runner
description: A yarn-dyed cotton runner in a half-inch gingham check, with a simple folded hem and a ticking stripe on the reverse so it can be flipped. It is the runner for a pine kitchen table, a jar of wildflowers and a pie cooling in the middle. Cozy, homely and already worn in.
details: 14 x 72 in; 14 x 108 in also available
100% cotton, yarn-dyed gingham front, ticking stripe back
Colors: Sage Check, Butter Check, Navy Check
Machine wash warm, tumble dry; iron on medium if you must
Made in Portugal

name: Carnival Jacquard Napkin (Set of 4)
description: Four cotton-linen napkins woven on a jacquard loom with an oversized leopard-and-stripe pattern in magenta, tangerine and plum, each one finished with a contrasting mitered border. They are built to be mixed with the florals, the gold flatware and whatever plates you fell in love with on vacation. Bold, playful and loud at the table in the best way.
details: 18 x 18 in; set of 4 in one pattern
55% linen, 45% cotton jacquard; 240 gsm
Patterns: Leopard (magenta/tangerine), Stripe (plum/tangerine)
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low; may be ironed on reverse
Made in Portugal

name: Hask Striped Linen Placemat (Set of 4)
description: Four heavyweight linen placemats woven with wide bands of burnt orange, chocolate and cream, in the proportions of a 1970s kitchen curtain. The linen is thick enough to lie flat under a plate and the stripes run lengthwise so they line up down a long table. Warm, chunky and groovy without trying too hard.
details: 14 x 19 in; set of 4
100% European linen, yarn-dyed stripe; 320 gsm
Colorways: Sunset (orange/brown/cream), Moss (olive/brown/cream)
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low; iron on reverse for a crisp finish
Made in Lithuania

name: Halden Stoneware Pour-Over Dripper
description: A cone-shaped pour-over in black stoneware with a thick wall that holds heat through the bloom and a single ridge inside for even drainage. It sits on any mug or carafe and takes a standard size 02 paper filter. Slow, low and spare, it belongs to a quiet morning rather than a rushed one.
details: Fits size 02 cone filters; brews 1 to 2 cups (up to 20 oz / 600 ml)
4.5 in tall, 4.75 in diameter at the rim
Black stoneware with a matte Ink glaze inside and out; Oat also available
Dishwasher safe
Includes 20 unbleached paper filters
Made in Japan

name: Elba Brass French Press
description: A 34-ounce French press with a fluted brass-finish stainless housing, a polished black knob and a borosilicate glass beaker you can see the bloom through. The ridges run top to bottom like a column and the plunger has a satisfying weight. Polished and a little theatrical, it belongs on a tray next to the good cups.

Stainless steel housing with PVD brass finish; borosilicate glass beaker
Double-mesh stainless filter; replacement beaker available
Beaker and filter are dishwasher safe; hand wash the housing

Gift boxed

name: Orbit Stoneware Teapot
description: A squat, round-bellied teapot in a glossy mustard or olive glaze, with a tapered spout, a bent walnut handle and a stainless infuser basket that lifts out with one finger. It pours clean and holds four cups, which is exactly enough for two people and a second round. Warm, curvy and a little bit 1962.

Stoneware body with lead-free gloss glaze; removable stainless infuser
Bent solid walnut handle with brass fittings
Hand wash the pot to protect the handle; infuser is dishwasher safe
Glazes: Mustard, Olive, Teal

name: Ferro Stovetop Kettle
description: A 1.7-liter stovetop kettle in powder-coated black steel with exposed rivets, a walnut-wrapped handle and a gooseneck spout slow enough for pour-over. It whistles, it works on induction, and it looks like it came out of a machine shop. Raw, utilitarian and built to sit on the back burner for a decade.
details: Capacity 57 oz / 1.7 L; 9 in tall, 8.5 in spout to handle
18/8 stainless steel body with matte black powder coat; walnut handle grip
Gooseneck spout; removable whistle cap
Works on gas, electric and induction; hand wash the exterior
Weight 2.4 lb
Finishes: Matte Black, Raw Steel

name: Zahra Hand-Painted Espresso Cup (Set of 4)
description: Four small handleless cups in red terracotta, each painted by hand with a different geometric pattern in cobalt, ochre and white over a cream slip. They hold a double shot or a pour of mint tea and stack into a short, cheerful tower on the counter. Collected, textured and a reminder of somewhere warmer.
details: Holds 3 oz / 90 ml; 2.5 in tall, 2.5 in diameter; set of 4 (patterns vary)
Terracotta clay with cream slip and hand-painted underglaze; clear gloss glaze
Dishwasher safe on the top rack; microwave safe
